earliest_visible_sign.description: Small pale green or yellowish swellings or localised distortion on young tissues, especially after wounds or insect damage.

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Round, oval, elongated, or irregular tumour-like galls covered by a smooth membrane.

colors.color_progression: Pale green/yellow-green to silvery-white/grey-white, becoming pale brown, with a black interior upon rupturing.

shape.shape_progression: Small swelling enlarges into a membrane-covered gall, which later ruptures and collapses into a dark, shrivelled mass or scar.

size.size_variation_note: Galls on ears can be much larger than leaf or tassel galls.

texture_and_surface.surface: smooth membrane when young, wrinkled or ruptured when mature
texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: black powdery interior after membrane rupture
texture_and_surface.other_surface_details: Ruptures to expose a dark brown to black mass of powdery teliospores.

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Mature galls rupture to release black spores, followed by gall collapse.
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Groups of kernels become greatly swollen galls; ears may be partially replaced by galls.
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: After spore release, the gall collapses, dries, and leaves a dark, shrivelled mass or scar.
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Infected ears may be severely distorted or largely replaced by galls, leading to major yield reductions.

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: All above-ground organs can be infected. Young plants may develop galls near growing points.
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: Often localized at infection sites, particularly through wounds or actively growing tissues.
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: Ear, kernels, leaf blade, leaf sheath, stalks, nodes, tassel, axillary buds, and occasionally roots.

pathognomonic_features: Large, silvery-white or grey-white tumour-like galls covered by a smooth membrane.
Galls rupture to expose a dark brown or black mass of powdery teliospores.
